newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish president to visit Germany for two days.
newsitem.headline: Polish president to visit Germany for two days.

text.p: Poland's President Aleksander Kwasniewski is to pay a working visit to Germany on Thursday and Friday during which he will meet Chancellor Helmut Kohl and other top officials, his office said.

It said in a statement on Tuesday that Kwasniewski would visit the Baden-Wuerttemberg chamber of commerce and industry in Stuttgart. He nd would give a lecture, in Freiburg, on Poland's reforms and another in St. Augustin on Polish-German relations.
His programme includes meetings with Kohl, Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel and Bundestag (lower house) speaker Rita Suessmuth.

His visit has been preceded by a conference on Polish-German relations in Bonn this week, during which Kinkel restated his country's firm backing for Poland's key foreign policy goals of joining the European Union and NATO.
